name: Deck numbers pass
prompt: Go through the live deck, memo and one-pager and check every figure against the canonical numbers in the vault. Replace each retired figure, cite the current source for each, and write the list of changes to {target}.
claim: Every figure in the live documents matches the canonical numbers and cites a current source.
rubric: Every figure in the live documents matches the canonical source.
Each replaced figure cites the current source, not a stale memo.
The change list names each file, the old figure and the new one.
No live document still holds a retired figure.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
